content.short: Space Troopers is a P2E NFT project providing a sci-fi gladiator game enabling players to earn weekly $Ada in arena rewards.
content.description:
Space Troopers is an art and gaming project, with utility. We are offering 3d modelled art, each individually rendered and all unique from one another, highly detailed and stylised, with original traits and some inspired by classic sci-fi. We are aiming for our art to be good enough to be considered an art project outright, but we are also providing reasons to hold your Space Trooper by adding returns and utility. Some of our NFTs will offer passive income, Ada sent straight to the wallet containing them from a portion of secondary sales. In addition we will also be offering a chance to enter your Space Trooper in daily battle royale combat via our website! They will earn medals over the week and at the end of the week, those with the highest (and one with the lowest) medals will be airdropped Ada.

Possibility to earn ADA weekly and monthly. Weekly income - Single Combat rewards from portion of secondary sales and any subscriptions to the arena game:

Monthly recurrent income - 10% of secondary sales: Higher rank NFTs (Patriarch or Matriarch) will be entitled to passive income, ‘spoils of war’ which will be distributed to the wallets holding them in the form of Ada received from 10% of secondary sales. Through our 'Destiny Choices' mechanic, commanders will be able to be promoted to matriarch/patriarch level, enabling them to join the passive income pay-out pool.

Rarity and Command Structure:

Limited supply of 1,000 NFTs. Additionally, other projects will be using the game with their own NFTs for a small fee. This income will add up for the weekly and monthly revenue from above.
